queries:
SELECT
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_share
FROM orders AS o
JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.orderbase

SELECT
    o.orderbase AS channel,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(oe.fillcount) AS execution_count,
    1.0 * COUNT(oe.fillcount) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(oe.fillcount)) OVER (), 0) AS share
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN orderexecutions AS oe
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.orderbase

WITH channel_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase AS channel,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS matched_order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  channel,
  avg_fillcount,
  matched_order_count,
  1.0 * matched_order_count / SUM(matched_order_count) OVER () AS matched_order_share
FROM channel_stats

WITH channel_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_fillcount,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count,
    SUM(e.fillcount) AS total_fillcount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  orderbase,
  average_fillcount,
  execution_count,
  total_fillcount / NULLIF(SUM(total_fillcount) OVER (), 0) AS fillcount_share
FROM channel_totals

WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderspivot,
    o.orderbase,
    SUM(e.fillcount) AS total_fillcount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  orderbase AS channel,
  AVG(total_fillcount) AS average_order_fillcount,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_fills) AS order_share
FROM order_fills
GROUP BY orderbase

WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderspivot,
    o.orderbase,
    COALESCE(SUM(e.fillcount), 0) AS filled_quantity
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  orderbase,
  AVG(filled_quantity) AS average_filled_quantity_per_order,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  SUM(filled_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(filled_quantity)) OVER (), 0) AS filled_quantity_share
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY orderbase
